local_webview2_inventory.scope: Read-only local installation inventory. Does not establish channel, runtime selection or actual runtime used by a native application. Loaded-module/file/product version receipts must establish that separately.

limitations: The registry latest stable version does not establish API compatibility, security status, enabled feature selection or native acceptance.

locked_workspace_identities includes every identity with the named crate in the corresponding lock, including transitive/different-major copies; it is not a claim that every identity satisfies the listed direct requirement.

Direct path dependencies are owned source boundaries and excluded from external registry currency comparison. Git source declarations are retained, but only Servo receives a current upstream-release comparison.

Local WebView2 installation inventory was read; other host runtime versions were not measured. Inventory does not prove which runtime any native process used. Native artifacts remain authoritative for their exact executable/runtime; this snapshot does not extend their qualification.
Concurrent Genet fontsan repair and consumer lock changes can supersede the observed input hashes; the initial feature-conflict evidence remains a dated failure control.
